facts.title: CSSFX - Beautifully simple click-to-copy CSS effects
facts.description: Browse a carefully crafted collection of loaders, hover effects, transitions, and other CSS effects to use in your next project. Effects are designed with an emphasis on fluidity, simplicity, and ease of use.

research.name: CSSFX
research.note: Click-to-copy CSS hover, input, loader and text effects with minimal markup.
